wire.headline: Energy Firm Cuts 850 Jobs as Profits Fall and Ofgem Probes Billing
sentences: The company reported that its revenue increased by 7% year over year to reach 4.26bn GBP for the quarter ending 30 September.
Pre-tax profit declined by 12% to stand at 310m GBP.
The firm announced plans to cut 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants, with one located in Wales and one in Kent, are scheduled to close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure has been sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend was held steady at 12.4p a share.
The company's shares dropped by 4.2% during morning trading.

PD.headline: Kestrel Securities cuts to save 90m GBP as Unite ballots on action

sentences.text: Reporting for the quarter ending 30 September, the company stated that its revenue grew by 7% year over year to hit 4.26bn GBP.
A Kestrel Securities analyst stated that the job cuts save 90m GBP a year.
Unite will ballot members on industrial action.

The MP for Deeside is asking for an urgent meeting with the company.

ND.headline: Energy firm reports profit drop and announces job cuts as regulatory scrutiny continues

sentences.text: The company reported a pre-tax profit decrease of 12% to 310m GBP.
A total of 850 job cuts are planned, which represents about 6% of the workforce.
An analyst from Kestrel Securities stated that the job cuts will save 90m GBP a year.
Unite has decided to ballot its members on taking industrial action.
The Kent plant employs 410 staff and has a local supply chain that is exposed.
The MP for Deeside has requested an urgent meeting with the company.
1,200 staff members have left under a voluntary scheme since 2024.
Ofgem is scheduled to report preliminary findings by end of 2026.
Shares closed at 268p, marking a drop of 11p.
A customer group logged 3,400 billing complaints in six months.
Talks with unions are set to start on 4 November.
Ofgem fined the company 1.8m GBP in 2023 over billing issues.
The company stated that there will be no compulsory redundancies before January 2027.
Kestrel Securities cut its price target to 240p from 290p.
This information is reported by the Western Mail.
